consensus.title: user:created event renamed without updating subscribers

responses.content:
* [CRITICAL] LOGIC `user:created` event renamed without updating subscribers (at `createUser`)
  - Issue: `createUser` now emits `userCreated`, but the registered subscribers listen for `user:created`. Every successful user creation therefore skips both `sendWelcome` and `trackSignup`, silently leaving users without the welcome email and without signup analytics.
  - Fix: Keep the existing event name (`bus.emit("user:created", user)`), or update every subscriber to use `userCreated` in the same change.

* [CRITICAL] LOGIC Event name mismatch breaks subscriber chain (at bus.emit in createUser)
  - Issue: The event name is changed from "user:created" to "userCreated", but the subscribers in src/notifications/subscribers.js are still registered for "user:created". This causes welcome emails and signup analytics to never fire when users are created, silently breaking critical user onboarding flows.
  - Fix: Either update subscribers to `bus.on("userCreated", sendWelcome)` and `bus.on("userCreated", trackSignup)`, or revert the event name change to maintain consistency.

[WARNING] LOGIC Silent failure of event subscribers due to event name mismatch (at bus.emit)
    - Issue: The event name emitted by createUser was changed from "user:created" to "userCreated", but the subscribers in src/notifications/subscribers.js still listen for "user:created". This causes sendWelcome and trackSignup to never execute when a user is created, silently breaking core functionality.
    - Fix: Revert the event name to "user:created" in the bus.emit call to match the existing subscribers.

[CRITICAL] LOGIC Event name mismatch breaks listeners (at line 8)
- Issue: The emit changed from "user:created" to "userCreated". Listeners registered for "user:created" will never be invoked, causing missing welcome emails and analytics tracking.
- Fix: Change bus.emit back to "user:created".
